contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' contributions (17,475.00) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is ALSO the attached typed ledger's own printed 'Total  $ 17,475.00' at the foot of p4, and ALSO summary line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' where the same figure is written '17,475.-' with a DASH IN THE CENTS POSITION
contributions.detail: The 11 rows of the filer's own typed contributions ledger (p4) sum to 1000.00 + 500.00 + 500.00 + 275.00 + 500.00 + 4000.00 + 5000.00 + 200.00 + 200.00 + 300.00 + 5000.00 = 17,475.00 EXACTLY = the ledger's printed Total = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell (Column A). The whole cover ladder closes on it too: line 3 Balance at Beginning 10,148.99 + line 4 17,475.00 = line 5 Subtotal 27,623.99, minus line 6 27,618.35 = line 7 Balance at Close 5.64, all as printed. NOTE THE CONTRAST WITH THIS FILER'S OWN OCTOBER FILING (06dd70a9), whose ledger total omitted its first and last rows: here the same filer's SUM covers every row, so the earlier delta was a one-off range slip and not a standing habit - screened, and the screen came back clean. Column B (Year-to-Date) is NOT summed as an increment; on this page its contributions cell is over-written and illegible (see notes) and it was neither needed nor used.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' expenditures (27,618.35) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is ALSO the attached typed ledger's own printed 'Total  $ 27,618.35' at the foot of p6, and ALSO summary line 6 'Total Expenditures Made (From Line 2 Column A)'
expenditures.detail: The 25 rows of the filer's own typed expenditure ledger (p6) sum to 27,618.35 EXACTLY = the ledger's printed Total = the cover's Column A. Every row was read individually and the sum was computed from the transcribed values, not from the printed total. Column B YTD 39,222.91 is retained as cumulative and never summed as an increment.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-ONLY AND MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND ARE IDENTICAL, tested both ways: NO row on either ledger is marked in kind (unlike this filer's October filing, where two rows were explicitly labelled 'In kind'), and the filing prints no in-kind line or column anywhere. Both conventions therefore give 17,475.00 on the contribution side and 27,618.35 on the expenditure side, and both close exactly. The one row that might tempt an in-kind reading - expenditure row 19, 'Bill Freeze / Reimbursement for FaceBook / 1,990.46' - is on the EXPENDITURE ledger, inside the range that closes to the cent, so it is a reimbursement paid out and not a contribution received.
itemized.escalation_note: No cell was doubtful: both ledgers are clean typed sheets and the cover is bold handwriting. The six 900 dpi crops taken are the mandatory geometry controls recorded in the frames. The one genuinely illegible cell on the filing - line 1 Column B, the cumulative contributions figure, which the filer over-wrote - was NOT escalated because it is a cumulative cell that this per-period regime never uses as an anchor; it is left honestly unread rather than guessed.

PAGE MAP, classified by each page's own printed header (6 pages): p1 cover ('2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5); p2 SUMMARY PAGE; p3 the county's SCHEDULE A form; p4 the candidate's own typed CONTRIBUTIONS ledger; p5 the county's SCHEDULE B form; p6 the candidate's own typed EXPENDITURES ledger, rotated landscape. Same structure and same filer as 06dd70a9 earlier in this chunk.

THE A2 CASE AGAIN: p3 and p5 are the county's printed Schedule A and Schedule B blanks and both are ENTIRELY UNFILLED - all 17 underlines empty on each, the Page/of, Last Name and Date of Report boxes empty, and both the 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total ... Received' lines empty. Per Addendum A2 that is NOT 'empty-schedule' and NOT 'no-schedule-page': what is missing is the county's FORM, not the filer's entries, so both sides are 'transcribed' from the attached ledgers. FOLIATION: every Page/of box on p2, p3 and p5 is blank, as on this filer's October filing.

AN ILLEGIBLE CELL, LEFT ILLEGIBLE ON PURPOSE: on the p2 Summary Page, line 1 Column B (cumulative contributions year-to-date) is written and then OVER-WRITTEN - the dollars read '39,228' but the cents are struck through and rewritten on top of themselves and cannot be resolved. It is recorded here as unread. It was NOT reconstructed: doing so would have meant adding this filing's period figure to a figure printed on a DIFFERENT cover, which the wave contract forbids ('never difference two covers to synthesize a figure'). The cell is a CUMULATIVE cell and this is a per-period regime, so nothing in this record depends on it. For contrast, line 2 Column B (cumulative expenditures) is legible at 39,222.91 and is likewise retained without being summed.

BOTH SIDES CLOSE EXACTLY, and that is itself the answer to a question this filer's October filing raised. There, both of his ledger totals omitted rows (a SUM range started one row low). The correlated-error screen the brief requires was therefore run here against the same filer's later document, and it came back CLEAN: 11 of 11 contribution rows and 25 of 25 expenditure rows are inside his totals, to the cent.

DATES: every row on both ledgers prints a day-and-month with NO YEAR ('28-Oct', '9-Nov'). Kept VERBATIM per the frozen contract; a year is never filled in from the report date, and the build blanks such a date and flags it. The dates span 27-Oct to 27-Nov, i.e. the 30-days-after-general window this report covers.

PRIVACY: both ledgers print full street lines and this file is NOT a *_Redacted.pdf - the county published it in the clear. Reduced to city/state at READ TIME; no street line reaches any field or note. Donor STATE is blank on the Utah rows because the ledger does not print one (only 'Chicago IL' carries a state); it is never inferred from the city, and no zip was converted into a city. Expenditure rows carry no address field at all, so the vendor address lines are dropped entirely.
